name: The Toymen on Bellemere Street
source:
Toymen earn their living banishing evil spirits from children's toys. Ever since experiencing their magic first hand, Juniper has been dreaming of becoming a toyman herself.

After years of studying, she's now finally entering an apprenticeship under a famous toyman, but her first day on the job doesn't go quite as expected...

[From [url=https://loude.itch.io/the-toymen-on-bellemere-street]itch.io[/url]]
